inlines.v: FORESLOW, verb transitive 1. To delay; to hinder; to impede; to obstruct. [Not used.] No stream, no wood, no mountain could foreshow their hasty pace. 2. To neglect; to omit. [Not used.] FORESLOW, verb intransitive To be dilatory; to loiter. [Not used.]
